cohort: The study included 100 postpartum cases from a tertiary care hospital.
finding: The prevalence of PPH was 23%, with significant risk factors including maternal age >=35 years, grand multiparity, cesarean delivery, prolonged labor, antepartum anemia, placenta previa/placental abruption, macrosomia, and pre-eclampsia.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as a significant risk factor for PPH (56%).
birth_weight: Macrosomia (unspecified weight, 5% of cases) was included as a risk factor.
